description.en: A single-plugin index, so Plugins -> Discover and the plugin_market tool can list and install dsh-session-rewind without npm.
description.zh: 单插件索引：不经过 npm，也能在「插件 → 发现」和 plugin_market 工具里浏览并安装 dsh-session-rewind。

description.en: Adds a rewind control to every finished Turn plus one entry in the session header. Pick a Turn to branch the conversation there into a new session, put that Turn's original prompt back in the composer so you can edit and resend it, and restore the workspace files that Turn changed to their pre-Turn content.
description.zh: 在每个已完成的回合旁加一个回退按钮，并在会话标题栏提供总入口：选中某个回合即可把对话从该回合处分叉成新会话，把该回合原本的输入放回输入框以便修改后重发，同时把该回合改动过的工作区文件恢复到修改前的内容。
